articles.title: SEC flags tokenization as high-risk area in 2027 market examinations
articles.snippet: The SEC’s latest priorities highlight tokenization as an emerging market risk, while cryptocurrencies remain absent as a standalone examination category.

articles.title: Fireblocks disputes report of $2.5B Visa acquisition talks
articles.snippet: Fireblocks told Cointelegraph that reports of a potential $2.5 billion acquisition by Visa are “not true at present time,” while Visa declined to comment on the reported talks.

articles.title: SoFi Launches Tokenized Deposit That Earns 4.4% and Converts to a Stablecoin
articles.snippet: Each SOFIE token represents $1 on deposit at SoFi Bank, earning 4.40% APY with FDIC insurance—a yield-and-protection combination ordinary stablecoins lack.

articles.title: Nvidia Unveils Its Full-Stack Blueprint to Contain and Monitor AI Agents
articles.snippet: Nvidia's OpenShell Reference Architecture pairs a software sandbox on Vera CPUs with Sentry monitoring on BlueField-4 chips, aiming to let companies run autonomous agents while enforcing limits agents cannot reach.
